mapper.insert: insert into class_session ( session_no, schedule_no, classroom_no, session_start, session_end ) values( #{sessionNo}, #{scheduleNo}, #{classroomNo}, #{sessionStart}, #{sessionEnd} )

insert into class_session ( session_no, schedule_no, classroom_no, session_start, session_end, session_status ) values( #{sessionNo}, #{scheduleNo}, #{classroomNo}, #{sessionStart}, #{sessionEnd}, #{sessionStatus} )
mapper.update: update class_session set session_status = #{sessionStatus}, session_end = SYSTIMESTAMP where session_no = #{sessionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT c.employee_no FROM class_session cs JOIN schedule sc ON cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no WHERE cs.session_no = #{sessionNo}
mapper.update: update class_session set session_status = '종료' where session_status = '진행중' and session_end < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT cs.* FROM class_session cs JOIN schedule sc ON cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no JOIN student_course sc_map ON sc.course_no = sc_map.course_no WHERE sc_map.student_no = #{studentNo} AND sc_map.student_course_status = '수강중' AND cs.session_status = '진행중' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN cs.session_start AND cs.session_end AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM class_session WHERE session_status = '진행중' AND session_end < SYSTIMESTAMP

select cs.session_no AS sessionNo, cs.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, cs.classroom_no AS classroomNo, cs.session_start AS sessionStart, cs.session_end AS sessionEnd, cs.session_status AS sessionStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_course sc_sub WHERE sc_sub.course_no = s.course_no AND sc_sub.student_course_status = '수강중') AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.attendance_state = '출석' THEN 1 END) AS presentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.attendance_state = '지각' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.attendance_state = '결석' THEN 1 END) AS absentCount from class_session cs join schedule s on cs.schedule_no = s.schedule_no left join attendance a on cs.session_no = a.class_session_no where s.course_no = #{courseNo} group by cs.session_no, cs.schedule_no, cs.classroom_no, cs.session_start, cs.session_end, cs.session_status, s.course_no order by cs.session_start asc

SELECT s.* FROM schedule s JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no WHERE s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY') AND s.schedule_start <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') AND s.schedule_end > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') AND c.course_status IN ('모집중', '진행중') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM class_session cs WHERE cs.schedule_no = s.schedule_no AND TRUNC(cs.session_start) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) )

select cs.session_no, cs.schedule_no,
cs.classroom_no, cr.classroom_name,
cs.session_start, cs.session_end, cs.session_status
from class_session cs
left join classroom cr on cs.classroom_no = cr.classroom_no
where cs.session_start >= #{weekStart} and cs.session_start < #{weekEnd}
order by cs.session_start asc
